name: car_enter
text: Standing next to the driver door of a car, use the left hand to pull the door open. Turn sideways, bend knees and duck the head, move hips sideways into the low driver seat first, then lift the outside leg over the sill and bring both feet forward into the footwell. Finish seated upright.
